_source: Verbatim copies of two pivota-backend constants, rendered by importing them (not retyped): services/catalog_row_trust_upserter.py CRAWL_LAST_PRICE_READ_SQL and services/external_offer_dual_write.py PRICE_CHECK_COLUMN_SQL, from pivota-backend commit e06083eb5 (feat(trust): CRAWL_FRESH, PR #2656). The gateway twin (src/services/catalogRowTrustUpserter.js) must emit the same bytes, except that the backend binds the key list as :product_keys (SQLAlchemy) where node-pg binds $1. If the backend constant changes, re-render this file from it; never hand-edit.
CRAWL_LAST_PRICE_READ_SQL:
SELECT k.product_key, r.last_price_read_at
  FROM unnest(CAST(:product_keys AS text[])) AS k(product_key)
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT max(co.price_checked_at) AS last_price_read_at
     FROM catalog_offers co
    WHERE co.product_key = k.product_key
      AND co.source_system = 'catalog_enrichment_agent_v1'
      AND co.suppressed_at IS NULL
      AND coalesce(co.merchant_effective_price, co.list_price) > 0
      AND co.price_checked_at IS NOT NULL
      AND btrim(coalesce(co.offer_payload->>'destination_url', co.source_ref), E' \t\n\r\f\v') ~ '^https?://\S+$'
      AND coalesce(co.offer_payload->>'validated_at', '') NOT LIKE 'affiliate_feed:%'
 ) r
 WHERE r.last_price_read_at IS NOT NULL
PRICE_CHECK_COLUMN_SQL:
SELECT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM pg_attribute
  WHERE attrelid = to_regclass('catalog_offers')
    AND attname = 'price_checked_at'
    AND attnum > 0
    AND NOT attisdropped
) AS present
